title: KG-Agent: An Efficient Autonomous Agent Framework for Complex Reasoning over Knowledge Graph

layout.note: Two full-width bands split by a dashed horizontal line. Top band (agent): question, planner triangle and bubbles at left, the knowledge-memory table in the middle, a four-row trace at right. Bottom band (data synthesis): query graph at left, colour-coded program box in the middle, two input-output template cards at right, linked by coloured and black dashed arrows.

lesson: Draw the agent as a triangle of large named icons next to a per-step trace that reuses the icons small, and colour graph regions and the code lines they generate alike, so the derivation of training data can be followed by colour.
